# One ECONNRESET in the e2e config route fails an app's boot

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

On 2026-11-17 the hosted CI of #21225 (head `f413710c29`) failed one e2e shard, `e2e-engine (3/14)` (run 44087668409, job 134054417175), at the boot of `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:1478`:

```
Error: route.fetch: socket hang up (ECONNRESET)
  - → GET http://localhost:36855/apps/workstation/neo-config.json
    at test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs:645:38

Error: page.goto: net::ERR_ABORTED; maybe frame was detached?
  - navigating to "http://localhost:36855/apps/workstation/index.html", waiting until "load"
    at boot (test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs:605:32)
```

The same spec passes locally on that head (11 passed, 3 skipped), and the failed job was re-run. On 2026-11-15 the same error hit the twin line, `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:374`, in a multi-window walk that runs on these fixtures: `route.fetch: read ECONNRESET` on a `neo-config.json`, once in 11 runs, after which the popup never booted and the test ran into its 90 s timeout.

Observed: the dev server that the e2e config starts (`webServer` in `test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs`) reset one connection, and the route handler that received it threw. Unknown: why the server resets.

## The Problem

Both Neural Link fixtures route every window's `neo-config.json` so they can rewrite it (`routeConfig`): they fetch the original with `route.fetch()`, then fulfill a changed copy. Without options `route.fetch()` makes one attempt. A single reset therefore rejects the handler, the app's config request fails, and the app never boots. Every spec that boots an app through these fixtures is exposed, which includes every NL spec and every popup a spec opens. The result is a red that clears on a re-run: it costs each author a diagnosis and a CI run, and it teaches the team to re-run reds without reading them.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs:374`: `routeConfig` in the `neuralLink` fixture.
- `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs:645`: its twin for dedicated-worker apps.
- Eleven spec-level route handlers also call `route.fetch()`:
  - `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockTabReorderGesture.spec.mjs:27`
  - `test/playwright/component/worker/InsecureHttpOrigin.spec.mjs:17` (passes `{url}`)
  - `test/playwright/e2e/core/AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs:62`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/core/ContentSecurityPolicy.spec.mjs:74`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/core/PathnameRouting.spec.mjs:21` and `:33` (the second passes `{url}`)
  - `test/playwright/e2e/grid/ColumnOverdragScroll.spec.mjs:290`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/portal/DocsMixinsNL.spec.mjs:116`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/portal/HighlightJsResources.spec.mjs:12`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/realworld/EmailMultiWindowNL.spec.mjs:117`
  - `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs:214`
- Playwright 1.65.1, the engine's version, documents a retry for exactly this error on `Route.fetch`'s options (`node_modules/playwright-core/types/types.d.ts`, `interface Route`): "Maximum number of times network errors should be retried. Currently only `ECONNRESET` error is retried. Does not retry based on HTTP response codes." `maxRetries` defaults to `0`.
- Design authority: n/a: a defect with its error and failing spec above.

## The Fix

Pass `maxRetries: 2` to `route.fetch()` at both fixture lines and at the eleven spec-level calls, merged into the options a call already passes (`route.fetch({url: url.href, maxRetries: 2})`). Leave everything after the fetch as it is: the config is still changed the same way, and a response that is not `ok()` is still fulfilled unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` and `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs` call `route.fetch({maxRetries: 2})` in `routeConfig`.
- [ ] Each of the eleven spec-level calls listed above passes `maxRetries: 2`, together with the options it already had. If one of them provokes a reset on purpose, it stays as it is, and the pull request says why.
- [ ] Nothing else changes: a search for `route.fetch(` under `test/` shows every call with `maxRetries`, and the diff touches no other line.
- [ ] The unit tier and the changed specs pass locally:
  ```
  npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs
  npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.component.mjs test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockTabReorderGesture.spec.mjs test/playwright/component/worker/InsecureHttpOrigin.spec.mjs
  npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFiveBeatNL.spec.mjs test/playwright/e2e/core test/playwright/e2e/portal/DocsMixinsNL.spec.mjs test/playwright/e2e/portal/HighlightJsResources.spec.mjs
  ```

## Out of Scope

- Why the dev server resets a connection under load. The retry absorbs a transient reset; a server that keeps resetting still fails the test after the retries, which is the right outcome.
- Retrying HTTP error statuses: `maxRetries` deliberately does not, and the fix should not either.
- `page.goto` and other requests the page makes on its own.
- A guard that requires `maxRetries` on new `route.fetch()` calls. That becomes worth it if a new spec shows the same failure.

## Avoided Traps

- **A hand-written retry loop around `route.fetch()`:** Playwright's own option covers exactly this error.
- **A longer test timeout:** the config request has already failed; waiting longer does not boot the app.
- **Re-running the job:** it clears one incident at the cost of one CI run, and the next author pays again.

## Related

#21225 (the run that failed) · #21209 (a different intermittent failure: a component-tier Workstation cold boot hitting its 30 s timeout) · `#13037` (an ECONNRESET during CI setup in June, re-run as transient; whether it was this route is not recorded).
